scope: Every first-party frozen product source file plus every extracted enum variant, declared field, operation, UI control, input binding, keyboard expansion and explicit format route. Transitive third-party implementation source is license-accounted separately.
limitations: Declaration inventory is intentionally broader than user-visible capability count; implementation-support rows are marked separately.

The lexical extractor is conservative, not a Swift/Rust/TypeScript compiler. File hashes, declaration-set comparison, explicit enum/format/keyboard checks and full file list prevent silent source changes; they do not prove semantic acceptance.

Exposed capabilities have planned semantic fixture profiles with individual source parameters; support declarations are provenance-only and are not presented as executable fixtures. Baseline test bodies are indexed as source evidence; this audit does not run them.
Compositor RAW import and Camera Raw Filter are RGBA8 baseline behavior, not live-RAW acceptance. Every retained pixel tool/kernel requires float/color-contract qualification.
System RAW recognition is dynamic. Freeze representative real camera fixtures per target macOS version; no enumerated camera support claim follows from UTType.rawImage.
PSD/PSB readers and conversion reports do not establish layered PSD/PSB export; sc-24675/sc-24676 own required writer and compatibility validation.
Existing PhotoCatalog image exports render its photo recipe. LensWorks must substitute the full layered live-RAW document render, preserve source identity, and adapt export provenance.
PhotoCatalog private/transport operations are retained behavior contracts mapped to adapter stories, not a promise to preserve the React/Tauri implementation.
Conditional Rust test modules embedded in product files are conservatively retained as support rows; baseline_test_cases identifies test evidence separately.
PhotoCatalog itself has no root license file at this pin; application ownership/licensing needs owner disposition while third-party notices are retained.

rgba-four.purpose: exact color, straight/premultiplied alpha, selection and invert assertions

edge64.construction: 64x64 transparent RGBA image; opaque white square x/y in [16,48), one opaque black pixel at (32,32)
edge64.purpose: blur, geometry, matte, paint and effect spatial assertions

ramp256.construction: 256x1 RGBA image pixel(x)=[x,x,x,255] for x in 0...255; companion same-size opaque flat gray [128,128,128,255]
ramp256.purpose: tone endpoints, monotonicity, identity, blur-flat-field assertions

hdr2.purpose: LensWorks precision contract; no source-byte mutation or premature clamp

catalog-two.construction: Use vendor/PhotoCatalog/tests/catalog.rs setup/jpeg/synthetic_cr2 helpers: a.jpg 96x64 with B=3; b.CR2 miniature TIFF/JPEG container 48x32 EXIF orientation=6; source folder originals ü 日本語 outside catalog
catalog-two.purpose: two stable identities, CR2 preview orientation (32,48), repeat-import unchanged=2, offline cached preview; synthetic CR2 is not real RAW-camera evidence

layered3.construction: 64x64 document: bottom rgba-four expanded to canvas, middle edge64 raster layer with half-opacity reveal mask, top editable text LensWorks; one group; source-identity and source-byte hashes recorded
layered3.purpose: layer graph, export, undo, save/reopen, standalone/import conversion

lightroom-frozen.construction: Execute retained Lightroom/capture/plan/migration test builders listed by each referenced baseline test ID in an isolated directory; immutable source descriptors and approval snapshots included
lightroom-frozen.purpose: source-backed full relationship, raw-payload, compatibility-report and interrupted migration assertions; do not invent undocumented Lightroom schema

real-raw.construction: Owner-selected real camera RAW fixture admitted by pinned decoder on target macOS, with file SHA-256, camera identity and embedded profile recorded before edit
real-raw.purpose: additional real-camera gate; requires concrete camera fixture selection before passing status
real-raw.unresolved: No single system-wide UTType/CIRAWFilter camera guarantee is possible from frozen source.
